Note on process: the core FigDown doc I was given tells me `flowchart` needs `reference/experimental/flowchart.md` before writing line 2, since it's a EXPERIMENTAL (experimental) genre. That reference file wasn't included in what you gave me, so I've composed the flowchart using the conventions the core doc *does* specify everywhere else — quoted labels, bare ids, one node declaration per line, and `->` edges with optional quoted branch labels — and I've called that choice out in the file itself so a reader can tell it's an inferred spelling rather than a copied one.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "BGP session reset procedure"

# reference/experimental/flowchart.md was not available at authoring time;
# node/edge spellings below follow the core skeleton's general conventions
# (quoted labels, bare ids, `->` edges). Verify against the genre file
# before relying on exact keyword names (process/decision/terminator).

process checkcounters "Check interface error counters"
decision errorsfound "Errors found?"
process clearcounters "Clear interface counters"
terminator monitor "Monitor session"
terminator escalate "Escalate to operator"

checkcounters -> errorsfound
errorsfound -> clearcounters "yes"
errorsfound -> escalate "no"
clearcounters -> monitor
```

Before treating this as final, run `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js bgp-session-reset.fd` — if `process`/`decision`/`terminator`/`->` aren't the genre's actual keywords, the parser will name the correct spellings as line errors, and the fix is mechanical from there.
